title: People free to protest against Congress: Priyanka Gandhi on police action against Kerala protesters

ai.summary: Congress MP Priyanka Gandhi Vadra defended the right to peaceful protests, stating people can agitate against Congress-led governments within legal bounds.

facts.claim: Congress MP Priyanka Gandhi Vadra defended the right to peaceful protests
facts.quote: Congress MP Priyanka Gandhi Vadra on Thursday defended the right to peaceful protests, saying people were free to agitate against Congress-led governments and their policies, as long as demonstrations remained within the law.
